notes.court-at-professors-row: Tufts housing says the Court is three halls at 91, 93 and 95 Professors Row (students.tufts.edu/residential-life-and-learning/campus-housing/first-year-undergraduate/court-professors-row); OSM has them as unnamed dormitories way/1340180874-6. Pinned on 93, the middle one.

detours.why: Richardson House's mapped door faces Professors Row at the top of the hill; the slope behind it down to the arts buildings on Talbot Avenue has no mapped path, so walks go round by the paths west of Mayer Campus Center.
Walnut Hill: these halls and buildings sit at different levels of the hill, joined only by a few mapped paths and stairs, so short straight-line hops become walks round by them.
